_note: Public-domain source URLs for REAL road-sign images, downloaded by fetch_signs.py into images/. Fill each with a public-domain / freely-licensed URL. Recommended: Wikimedia Commons stable direct links via the Special:FilePath pattern, e.g. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/MUTCD_R1-1.svg . Leave a value empty ('') to skip it (question stays text-only). Diagram/scenario illustrations (fourway, uncontrolled, roundabout, leftturn, mark-*, signal-*) are intentionally omitted — they have no standard public-domain equivalent; use extract_figures.py to pull those from a handbook PDF if wanted.
